class S2D4P.inference.dataloader.BatchData(input: Tensor, added_features: Tensor | None = None, metadata: list[dict] | None = None, return_spatial_mask: bool = False, share_spatial_mask: bool = False)

Bases: BatchDataABC

Container for a batch of inference data.

Input NaN values are replaced with zeros after optional spatial validity masks are constructed.

Parameters:

  • input (torch.Tensor) – Batched model input tensor.

  • added_features (torch.Tensor | None) – Optional additional features associated with the batch.

  • metadata (list[dict] | None) – Per-sample metadata associated with the batch.

  • return_spatial_mask (bool) – Whether to construct a validity mask from non-NaN input values.

  • share_spatial_mask (bool) – Whether to reduce the validity mask across the batch dimension and reuse it as a shared mask.

class S2D4P.inference.dataloader.InferenceDataloaderConfig(dataset: InferenceDatasetConfig | None = None, batch_size: int = 1, inference_years_slice: tuple | list | None = None, num_data_workers: int = 0, prefetch_factor: int | None = None, drop_last: bool = False, load: bool = False, share_spatial_mask: bool = False)

Bases: DataloaderConfigABC

Configuration for an inference data loader.

Parameters:

  • dataset (InferenceDatasetConfig | None) – Configuration used to construct the inference dataset. If None, it can be derived from a training data-loader configuration.

  • batch_size (int) – Number of inference samples in each batch.

  • inference_years_slice (tuple | list | None) – Optional start and stop years restricting the inference period.

  • num_data_workers (int) – Number of worker processes used for data loading.

  • prefetch_factor (int | None) – Number of batches prefetched by each data-loading worker.

  • drop_last (bool) – Whether to discard the final incomplete batch.

  • load (bool) – Whether underlying dataset contents are loaded into memory when opened.

  • share_spatial_mask (bool) – Whether spatial validity masks are reduced across the batch dimension and shared between batches.

Populate inference settings from a training data-loader configuration.

setup_distributed(train_loader_config: TrainDataloaderConfig, distributed: Distributed, load_path: Path | str | None = None)

Configure inference data loading for distributed execution.

Missing preprocessing pipelines are fitted and saved by the root process using the training configuration. Processes are synchronized before the fitted pipelines are loaded for inference.

Parameters:

  • train_loader_config (TrainDataloaderConfig) – Training data-loader configuration used to fit missing preprocessing pipelines.

  • distributed (Distributed) – Distributed runtime containing process rank and world-size information.

  • load_path (Path | str | None) – Directory containing fitted preprocessing pipelines. If None, the default experiment preprocessing directory is used.

share_spatial_mask: bool = False

class S2D4P.inference.dataset.InferenceDataset(config: InferenceDatasetConfig, requested_times: Sequence[datetime64 | datetime | datetime] | ndarray | DataArray, time_features: AddedTimeFeatures, return_metadata: bool = False, load: bool = False)

Bases: DatasetABC

Dataset for constructing model inputs during inference.

Samples are assembled from forecast and conditioning data according to the configured conditioning strategy. Optional temporal features and sampling metadata are included with each sample.

Parameters:

  • config (InferenceDatasetConfig) – Configuration defining inference data sources and sampling behavior.

  • requested_times (Sequence[np.datetime64 | datetime.datetime | cftime.datetime] | np.ndarray | xr.DataArray) – Initialization times requested for inference.

  • time_features (AddedTimeFeatures) – Temporal feature generator applied to samples.

  • return_metadata (bool) – Whether each sample is returned with its sampling-coordinate metadata.

  • load (bool) – Whether underlying xarray data are loaded into memory when opened.

S2D4P.inference.inference_configs module

class S2D4P.inference.inference_configs.InferenceConfig(experiment_dir: str, writer: ~S2D4P.core.writer.WriterConfig = <factory>, inference_loader: ~S2D4P.inference.dataloader.InferenceDataloaderConfig = <factory>, save_path: str | None = None, seed: int | None = None, checkpoint_name: str | None = None)

Bases: object

Configuration for an inference workflow.

Loads the training configuration associated with an experiment, reconstructs the training data-loader settings, and resolves compatible inference dataset and preprocessing settings.

Parameters:

  • experiment_dir (str) – Directory containing the trained experiment configuration, checkpoints, and fitted preprocessing pipelines.

  • writer (WriterConfig) – Configuration controlling prediction and output writing.

  • inference_loader (InferenceDataloaderConfig) – Configuration used to construct the inference data loader.

  • save_path (str | None) – Directory in which inference outputs are saved. If None, the inference directory under the experiment directory is used.

  • seed (int | None) – Base random seed used during inference. If None, no seed is explicitly configured.

  • checkpoint_name (str | None) – Checkpoint filename to load. If None, best.pt is used.

checkpoint_name: str | None = None

S2D4P.inference.predict.main(yaml_config: str)

Run the inference workflow from a YAML configuration file.

Initializes the distributed runtime, loads and constructs the inference configuration, sets a rank-specific random seed, prepares runtime directories, and builds the inference writer. The writer is then configured for distributed execution and used to generate and aggregate predictions. Distributed resources are cleaned up when execution completes or an exception is raised.

Parameters:

yaml_config (str) – Path to the YAML file containing the inference configuration.
